mechanism: Strategic postponement. When facing a decision under high uncertainty, run the {{epistemic_roi}} test on waiting: what would I learn, and would it change the decision? If yes, defer with a deadline; if no, decide now. Relies on {{prioritize}} to re-insert the task once the waiting condition is met.
gloss: Postponing decisions until more information available
failure_modes: {{decision}} debt: deferred choices accumulate until the deadline forces rushed decisions.
Deferred into forgotten: the WakeUpCondition never fires and no deadline was set.
invariants: Waiting passes the {{epistemic_roi}} test: some outcome of waiting changes the decision.
Both a WakeUpCondition and a deadline are explicit. A condition may never fire; a deadline always does.
